title: Lint rules for repeated, impossible and misleading expressions and source text
summary: Warns about a repeated operand in an and / or chain, comparisons that cannot all hold, a Boolean comparison with the wrong precedence, a function that reads its own name, warnings switched off for good and look-alike letters inside identifiers
intro: Read this to see what each of the six expression and source-text rules reports, what it leaves alone and how often it was wrong on real code.
